fusions.name: Seeded Mandate
fusions.desc: A strike with the rod that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Hushing Spores
fusions.desc: Puffs a cone 4 tiles long that deals 3 damage to everything in it, with a 25% chance to leave each [Muddled] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Fruiting Standard
fusions.desc: Plants a fruiting rod for 12 seconds. It strikes an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Rooted Influence
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You carry 8% poison resistance.
